subject: Application received: Backend Engineer
body: Thanks for applying to ZenTech for the Backend Engineer role. We have received your resume and will get back to you if your profile is shortlisted.

subject: Offer letter - pay Rs 4,999 training fee
body: Congratulations! You are selected for the Systems Engineer role at Infosys. Pay the refundable Rs 4,999 training fee via UPI today and send Aadhaar and PAN copies to confirm your joining.

subject: Interview invite: Round 1 on 27 Oct (Full Stack Engineer)
body: Hi, our engineering team loved your profile for the Full Stack Engineer role at Finly. Please pick a slot for a 45-minute technical call on 27 Oct covering REST APIs, database indexing, and system design.

subject: Application Confirmation - Python Developer
body: Thank you for applying to CloudScale for the Python Developer position. Our recruiting team is reviewing applications and will reach out soon.

subject: Update on your application with NovaPay (Data Engineer)
body: Thank you for taking the time to apply for the Data Engineer role at NovaPay. Unfortunately, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience aligns closer to our current needs.

subject: URGENT: Direct Joining Offer without Interview!
body: Dear Candidate, your resume was shortlisted for Software Developer at TCS (CTC 12 LPA). No interview required. Send scanned copies of your PAN card, Aadhaar card, and bank passbook within 2 hours to generate your offer letter.

subject: We received your application: Computer Vision Engineer
body: Hi there! We received your application for the Computer Vision Engineer role at PixelCraft AI. Our hiring managers are currently evaluating candidates.

subject: Official Offer of Employment: Software Development Engineer I
body: We are thrilled to offer you the position of Software Development Engineer I at VerveHealth! Attached is your detailed compensation breakdown (11.5 LPA base). Please review and e-sign via DocuSign by Oct 29.

subject: Status of your application - Backend Developer
body: We appreciate your interest in Kinetix Labs. After careful consideration, we regret to inform you that we will not be pursuing your candidacy for the Backend Developer position at this time.

subject: Selected for Remote AI Developer - Complete Laptop Security Deposit
body: Welcome aboard to GlobalAI Tech! Before we dispatch your company MacBook Pro, you must pay a refundable Rs 3,500 courier & insurance deposit to our finance account.

subject: Application submitted: Machine Learning Engineer
body: Thanks for applying to DataMind for the Machine Learning Engineer position. Your application is currently under review by our AI engineering team.

subject: Pre-Interview Mandatory KYC Verification
body: To schedule your Round 1 interview for the Android Developer position, please reply immediately with front and back photos of your Aadhaar card, PAN card, and a selfie holding your ID.

subject: Technical Interview Invitation: Backend Role at RazorFlow
body: Hi! Congratulations on clearing the resume screening for the Backend Engineer role at RazorFlow. Your 60-minute live coding and concurrency interview is scheduled for Oct 28 at 11:00 AM IST.

subject: Thanks for applying to ByteGrid (Platform Engineer)
body: We have received your application for the Platform Engineer role at ByteGrid. If there is a match, our talent team will reach out to schedule an initial screen.

subject: Your application for Embedded Systems Engineer at AtherWorks
body: Thank you for applying to AtherWorks. Due to a high volume of applicants post-layoffs, we are unable to move forward with your application for the Embedded Systems Engineer role.

subject: Application Received: DevOps Engineer
body: Hi! Thanks for sending in your application for the DevOps Engineer opening at FreshStack. We just received it and will review it over the coming week.

subject: Confirmed Joining Letter - Pay Rs 2,500 Verification Charge
body: Dear Applicant, you have been directly selected for Wipro Elite NTH role. Please pay Rs 2,500 towards background verification charges by 5 PM today to avoid cancellation of your offer.

subject: Interview Round 2: System Design with Hiring Manager
body: Great job in Round 1! We would like to invite you to Round 2 for the Software Engineer role at Credence Tech on Oct 26. Focus areas: distributed caching, SQL query optimization, and microservices.

subject: Application received for Deep Learning Engineer
body: Thank you for applying for the Deep Learning Engineer role at NeuroVision AI. Your profile has been logged into our applicant tracking system.

subject: Update on your Software Engineer candidacy at CartDash
body: Hi from CartDash HR! Although we have a strange email domain in this test, we regret to inform you that the Software Engineer position has been filled and we cannot proceed with your application.
